text:
aj: Heads up — saw a ~22% cost bump in the A100 spot pool over the last 24h due to bursty evictions. Thinking about moving to a mixed-instance-type spot pool to reduce eviction risk and smooth price, but worried about packing/fragmentation and its impact on utilization & p95 latency. Anyone run experiments on shape-aware packing vs family affinity?

maria: We ran a small pilot last month. Mixed A100+H100 reduced evictions ~40% but introduced ~7% overhead from heterogeneous driver handling and slightly higher variance in latency. Overall cost per useful-token improved.

chen: What scheduler did you use? We used a shape-aware allocator that packs by VRAM footprint + power class — helped a lot with fragmentation. Quick snippet we used: ```json
{"allocator":"shape-aware","shapes":[{"vram_gb":80},{"vram_gb":40}],"pack_threshold":0.92}```

samir: If you bias toward cheaper families first (e.g. G5-like) and fallback to A100/H100 for tight latency paths you can get better unit cost but higher tail latency. Good trade for async batch workloads.

katie: Also consider interruption handling: checkpoint more frequently or use prefix/KV caching so preemptions waste less compute. For chat we checkpoint conversation state every 128 tokens which helped reduce rework.

ops-bot: autoscaler: triggered scale-up +20% in spot-mixed pool (policy: eviction-buffer=0.15) :warning:

aj: Plan suggestion — run a 2-week A/B: control=a100-only spot, variant=mixed(A100,H100,G5) with shape-aware packing, eviction-buffer=15%. Track: cost per 1k tokens, p50/p95/p99 latencies, eviction count, wasted_gpu_seconds.

maria: I'll spin up infra experiment repo and images. Need H100 driver + cuDNN parity; will coordinate with eng-runtime for kernel flags.

chen: Heads-up: mixing H100+A100 in the same batch reduced multi-instance batching throughput in our test. Might need family-isolated batch lanes: small/low-latency to A100-only, bulk batch to mixed.

samir: I'll codify a canary fallback: if p99 latency > 1.5x baseline for 10m, route traffic back to reserved pool.

katie: Add metric for "wasted_gpu_seconds" from preemptions, and "frag_util" (fragmentation-utilization) so we can quantify packing loss.

aj: Action items: maria -> infra PR + images; samir + chen -> allocator + fallback config; katie -> metrics dashboard. Ping me when PR is up. :eyes:
